errors.description: The agent used the final_answer tool to submit the task description instead of issuing a request to the search_agent to retrieve the required information. This incorrect tool selection prevented the system from accessing the necessary data and caused a deviation from the intended goal.
By passing the task description to final_answer, the system fabricated an inappropriate final answer, effectively hallucinating tool output rather than delivering the actual requested value.
The system failed to provide the numerical day from November as required by the user’s question, thereby not complying with the explicit instruction to give the correct answer.
By outputting an inadequate answer, the agent deviated from the core objective of finding and returning the specific day of the month referenced in the book’s endnote.
